integrity: All-parameter analytic proof with independently replayable symbolic algebra; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result treats a single planar, three-row, consistent tight frame with common constant overrelaxation.
A new independent uniform permutation is drawn each reshuffled epoch.
The one-epoch/multi-epoch comparison uses each algorithm’s asymptotic-rate-optimal fixed relaxation; finite-horizon cyclic relaxation is not reoptimized.
The deterministic comparison is worst-case initial direction; the random comparison is expected squared norm, not an almost-sure exponent.
Precedence in specialist projection-product and frame literature remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp cyclic–reshuffling rate reversal for a three-line tight Kaczmarz frame
